name: Clio Manage
hint: An application’s key and secret from the Clio developer portal, and a refresh token; outside the US use your region’s host (eu, ca or au.app.clio.com).

endpoints.name: list_matters
endpoints.description: Lists matters. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,display_number,description,status,client{name}.

notes.query: Wildcard search for `display_number`, `number` or `description` matching a given string, as well as the `first_name`, `last_name` or `name` of the associated client.
notes.status: Filter Matter records to those with a given status. It accepts comma-separated statuses, e.g. `open,pending`.
notes.client_id: The unique identifier for a single Contact. The keyword `null` is not valid for this field. The list will be filtered to include only the Matter records with the matching property.
notes.limit: A limit on the number of Matter records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.
notes.fields: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

endpoints.name: get_matter
endpoints.description: Returns one matter. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more.

notes.id: The unique identifier for the Matter.
notes.fields: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

endpoints.name: list_contacts
endpoints.description: Lists contacts: the people and companies linked to matters. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,name,type,primary_email_address.

notes.query: Wildcard search for name, title, email address, address, phone number, web site, instant messenger address, custom fields, related matter name, or company name matching a given string.
notes.type: Filter Contact records to those that match the given type.
notes.limit: A limit on the number of Contact records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.
notes.fields: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

notes.id: The unique identifier for the Contact.
notes.fields: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

endpoints.name: list_activities
endpoints.description: Lists time entries and expenses, for one matter or all. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,type,date,quantity,total,note.

notes.matter_id: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Activity. The list will be filtered to include only the Activity records with the matching property.
notes.type: Filter Activity records to those of a specific type.
notes.limit: A limit on the number of Activity records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.
notes.fields: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

endpoints.name: list_calendar_entries
endpoints.description: Lists calendar entries. Clio returns only id and etag unless fields names more, e.g. id,summary,start_at,end_at.

notes.matter_id: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a CalendarEntry. The list will be filtered to include only the CalendarEntry records with the matching property.
notes.from: Filter CalendarEntry records to those that end on or after the provided time (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
notes.to: Filter CalendarEntry records to those that begin on or before the provided time (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
notes.limit: A limit on the number of CalendarEntry records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

endpoints.name: create_activity
endpoints.description: Creates a time or expense entry. Body: {"data": {"type": "TimeEntry", "date", "quantity" (seconds), "note", "matter": {"id"}}}.

endpoints.name: create_note
endpoints.description: Adds a note to a matter or a contact. Body: {"data": {"type": "Matter", "subject", "detail", "matter": {"id"}}}.
